intermediate.name: Col de Mont-Louis
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Col de Mont-Louis (157.8 km)

story: Stage 3 of La Vuelta 2026 saw an early breakaway of six riders, with Ethan Hayter collecting points. However, due to increasing rain, thunder, and hail on the first climb, the race jury cancelled the stage. Consequently, no winner was declared for this stage.
